label: Web Tools
gloss: The hex nut: the Web Tools app's favicon, and the hub's mark wherever the app stands for itself.

label: Repositories
gloss: One mark per estate repository, painted in the text colour wherever the app names that repository.

label: Map
gloss: The Map's tab groups and its outposts, painted in the text colour on the tab strip and the Contents headings.

label: Projects
gloss: A project's own icon, an SVG in its repository or a Phosphor glyph, read from each repository's projects declarations.

label: Programs
gloss: A program's own icon, read from each repository's programs declarations.

label: Agents
gloss: One icon per agent definition the portable plugin ships; an inline reader has none.

label: Assistants
gloss: Which assistant wrote a branch or a commit, drawn as a stroke mark in that assistant's colour.

label: Map addresses
gloss: The glyph each Map subview wears on its tab and in Contents.

label: Repository glyphs
gloss: The glyph a repository declares as its icon, drawn where the hub keeps no mark for it.

label: Subjects
gloss: The glyph for each type of subject on screen, worn by the app drawer's layer row.

label: Tools
gloss: The glyph each page in the Tools view wears.

label: UI unit codes
gloss: The glyph each interface-unit code wears in the Browser tab's Dimensions.

label: Closing states
gloss: The marker that opens a reply's last line and says where the session stands.

label: Conversation rules
gloss: The marker a conversation rule's link or line carries in a reply.

label: Showing mechanisms
gloss: The marker each kind of link carries in a reply's render line.
